profile.headline: Software Engineer at Commonwealth Computer Research, Inc. (CCRi)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked with employees and other interns to create web apps using PostgreSQL and Angular. Documented existing projects via wiki and readme edits. Participated in daily Scrum meetings and weekly sprint plannings. Presented work to stakeholders and users. Created a working web app for internal use by the company

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Conducted long-term library research projects with primary and secondary sources and reported back to professional researchers. Located books and writing summaries for use in specialized bibliographic database. Used Excel to manage and organize lists of people and places. Conducted independent library research and wrote two articles available at the Mount Vernon George Washington Digital Encyclopedia (see links).

positions.title: Administrative and Financial Planning Intern
positions.description: Independently completed tasks that have very low tolerance for mistakes. Wrote Key Financial Systems Manual by interviewing 8 employees about their tasks and writing a 68-page document of all company processes. Created client profiles in cash flow analysis software and reviewed default inputs for appropriateness. Returning in Summer 2015 as Intern Liaison to design an intern program and assist with training of new interns
